prompt: Evaluate a 12-month cloud migration and staffing plan: (1) Compute annual cloud infrastructure cost for 240,000,000 API requests/year at $0.15 per 1,000 requests plus $1,200/month fixed platform fees; (2) Compute annual support staffing cost for 3 engineers at $85/hour for 1,920 billable hours each per year; (3) Determine the total annual cost and remaining budget out of a $600,000 annual allocation, and state whether the plan stays under budget.

roster.instructions: Calculate the annual cloud infrastructure cost using the request volume, per‑thousand‑request rate, and monthly fixed platform fees.
Calculate the annual support staffing cost for the three engineers based on hourly rate and billable hours.
Combine the cloud and staffing costs, compare the total to the $600,000 allocation, and report remaining budget and status.

execution_plan.goal: Evaluate a 12‑month cloud migration and staffing plan, calculate all relevant costs, and determine if the plan stays within a $600,000 annual budget.
user_requirements: Compute annual cloud infrastructure cost for 240,000,000 API requests/year at $0.15 per 1,000 requests plus $1,200/month fixed platform fees.
Compute annual support staffing cost for 3 engineers at $85/hour for 1,920 billable hours each per year.
Determine total annual cost, remaining budget from $600,000, and state whether the plan stays under budget.
acceptance_criteria: All calculations use the figures provided by the user.
Results are presented with clear numeric values (in USD) for cloud cost, staffing cost, total cost, remaining budget, and budget status.
The budget status explicitly says "under budget" or "over budget".

tasks.title: Calculate Annual Cloud Infrastructure Cost
tasks.description: Use 240,000,000 API requests per year, $0.15 per 1,000 requests, and $1,200 monthly fixed fees to compute the total cloud cost for one year.
acceptance_criteria: Cost includes both per‑request charges and monthly platform fees.
Result is expressed in USD and rounded to the nearest dollar.
tasks.findings: The annual cloud infrastructure cost for 240,000,000 API requests, at $0.15 per 1,000 requests plus $1,200 monthly fixed platform fees, is $50,400.

tasks.title: Calculate Annual Staffing Cost
tasks.description: Compute the yearly cost for 3 engineers each working 1,920 billable hours at $85 per hour.
acceptance_criteria: Cost is expressed in USD and rounded to the nearest dollar.
tasks.findings: The annual staffing cost for three engineers working 1,920 billable hours each at $85 per hour is $489,600.

tasks.title: Aggregate Costs and Determine Budget Status
tasks.description: Add the cloud infrastructure cost and staffing cost, compare the sum to the $600,000 allocation, and report remaining budget and whether the plan is under or over budget.
acceptance_criteria: Total cost equals the sum of cloud and staffing costs.
Remaining budget = $600,000 – total cost.
Budget status clearly states "under budget" if remaining budget ≥ 0, otherwise "over budget".
tasks.findings: Annual cloud infrastructure cost is $50,400 and annual staffing cost is $489,600. Total annual cost = $540,000. Remaining budget from the $600,000 allocation = $60,000. Budget status: under budget.
